verdict.rationale: Cekura's A/B testing guide documents comparing two agent versions side by side to measure prompt, model, or configuration changes, with metric-by-metric comparison of two selected runs on the Results page. Running the same scenarios across platforms and models adds supporting evidence. missing for 10: details on the comparison view (diff of individual conversations, statistical significance, automatic regression flagging), comparison of more than two runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions

citations.quote: Compare two versions of your agent side-by-side to measure prompt, model, or configuration changes.
Select both runs on the Results page and compare metric-by-metric.
Run the same scenarios across platforms and models. Pick the one that actually performs.
